subject: Intermittent 429s — quota routing mismatch and remediation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novanet.com>, NovaNet Support <support@novanet.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent 429s — quota routing mismatch and remediation

Hi Elena / NovaNet team,

We observed a spike of 429 responses affecting a subset of requests from your account beginning ~07:55 PDT this morning. Error patterns show short, repeated bursts across a few API routes (notably /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings), resulting in visible failures in a handful of user flows you reported.

Immediate actions we are taking:
- SREs (Evelyn + Marcus) are investigating routing and quota mapping for your tenant.
- We have queued a rollback of yesterday's tenant-mapping rollout to stop the bursts if it’s the source.
- We'll provide a short postmortem and a remediation timeline within 48 hours.

Can you confirm the approximate start time and whether you saw any user-facing errors? If you have sample request-ids, please send them — it will speed root cause.

Apologies for the disruption. I’ll keep you updated every hour until we stabilize.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novanet.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:25:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 429s — quota routing mismatch and remediation

Thanks Jordan — we saw a spike starting ~07:50 PDT. Our telemetry shows ~12% error rate for requests to /v1/generate between 07:50–08:05, then intermittent afterwards. User impact: some customers saw failed submissions in the mobile app and a small number of queued jobs timed out.

Sample request ids: req_20270510_77ab, req_20270510_77ac, req_20270510_77b0. Let me know if you need logs from our side.

We appreciate the quick triage.

—Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Integrations | NovaNet
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novanet.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:03:45 -0700
Subject: RE: Intermittent 429s — initial findings

Jordan / team,

Quick update from SRE: we correlated NovaNet request IDs with our ingress traces and saw a mismatch in tenant-to-quota routing that began after the tenant-mapping deployment at 06:43 PDT. The new mapping rule erroneously assigned a small subset of NovaNet traffic to a lower-rate quota bucket due to an edge-case tenant id parser (leading zeros).

Root cause hypothesis: the parser change in the mapping rollout did not include a normalization step for tenant identifiers with leading zeros. That caused ~8–15% of traffic to be routed to the legacy quota bucket with a stricter enforcement window, generating surge 429s under normal load.

Immediate remediation performed at 08:40 PDT: we rolled back the mapping change and applied a hotpatch to normalize tenant ids before routing. Early telemetry shows a drop in 429s to baseline. Attaching the extracted mapping logs for your reference.

Attachment: tenant-mapping-log-20270510.txt (excerpts: routing decisions + request samples)

Next steps I recommend:
- Confirm NovaNet sees improvements end-to-end.
- We will run a targeted replay of 07:30–08:15 traffic in our staging to validate the fix and run additional property-based tests on the parser.
- Engineering will prepare a permanent fix that includes automated regression checks and an explicit normalization test case.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Principal SRE | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novanet.com>, NovaNet Support <support@novanet.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:22:30 -0700
Subject: RE: Mitigation complete — confirmation + next steps

Elena — thanks for the quick confirmation on impact.

We rolled back the tenant-mapping change and applied normalization hotpatch at 08:40 PDT. Our current indicators show 429s for NovaNet have returned to baseline (sub-0.5% across affected routes). Please verify on your side when you can and share any additional request ids if you still see anomalies.

Compensation and operational follow-up:
- We opened ticket INF-9273 to track the engineering remediation and automated tests.
- We're issuing a one-time goodwill credit of 10% of May usage as a starting offer; finance will push an invoice credit and we’ll attach the transaction stub when posted.

I’ll send a short postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow and propose times for a walkthrough.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit-transaction-INV-9012.pdf

Cc: NovaNet Support <support@novanet.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:15:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Mitigation complete — confirmation + next steps

Thanks — we see a meaningful reduction in 429s and successful retries are now completing. We did notice a small cluster of failing jobs around 09:10 PDT that may be a delayed retry storm; I’ve included the request ids in the linked Drive doc.

We’d like a formal postmortem and a timeline for the permanent fix (including regression tests that would catch this parser/normalization issue). Also please confirm the credit mechanics and expected invoice adjustment date so we can reconcile.

Could we schedule a 45-minute postmortem review tomorrow (Wed) afternoon?

—Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Integrations | NovaNet
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novanet.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling postmortem + draft summary attached

Elena — thanks for the confirmation and the extra request ids. We’ve scheduled the postmortem review for Thu, 13 May 2027 at 14:00 PDT (calendar invite sent).

Attached is a short draft postmortem with timeline, technical root cause, and proposed action items including ETA for permanent fix and verification steps:
- Permanent fix (parser normalization + explicit unit/regression tests): targeted rollout Tuesday next week (18 May) with phased canary and QA checks.
- Additional mitigation: add a pre-deployment canary for tenant-mapping changes and expand parser test coverage.
- Compensatory credit: finance will apply a 10% credit to the May invoice; expect visible adjustment on the invoice posted 2027-05-20.

Attachments: postmortem-draft-novanet-20270512.md

If that looks good I’ll finalize the doc and provide the full signal export (request-level traces, quota decisions) for your security/audit team.

Appreciate your patience — we’ll follow up with the engineering ticket and a summary of test cases added once the fix is live.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
